description: MUTATES Autumn billing data — attaches (subscribes) a plan to a customer; may create an invoice / return a payment URL. Autumn API: POST /v1/billing.attach. Returns { customer_id, invoice, payment_url, required_action }.

checkout_session_params.description: Extra Stripe checkout session params (can carry metadata).

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer to attach the plan to.

customize.description: Optional plan overrides (price, items, licenses, free trial).

entity_id.description: The ID of the entity to attach the plan to.

feature_quantities.description: Prepaid feature quantities: array of { feature_id, quantity?, adjustable? }.

invoice_mode.description: Invoice-mode configuration object (send an invoice instead of auto-charging).

redirect_mode.description: Checkout redirect mode: always, if_required, or never.

success_url.description: URL to redirect to after a successful checkout.

version.description: The version of the plan to attach.

name: attach_plan
title: Attach a plan
